# To do

To do is a fast productivity Progressive Web App (PWA) to organize tasks
and simplify your life. It supports task tabs, accounts (Google sign-in)
and works offline as an installable app.

## Canonical URL
- https://todo.bobagi.space/

## Language
- English (en)

## Important pages
- Home / App: https://todo.bobagi.space/

## Source
- GitHub: https://github.com/Bobagi/todo
